stable.notes: Work cards drag between columns and into the session row. A dropped card that meets every criterion (no earlier handoff, a certain destination, a session that is not busy) counts down, sends and opens its session; anything less asks first. A handoff COS lost track of can be continued in the same session after one confirm. Includes 0.5.244 and 0.5.245. Pairs with server 6.57.1.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
